app_info.subtitle: Search and update your wiki
app_info.description: Kinic Wiki connects ChatGPT to wiki databases available to the signed-in user. It can discover and search databases, read task-focused context and evidence, create or replace nodes, and apply atomic append, edit, move, or delete operations with etag conflict protection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists and ranks database metadata visible to the signed-in user without modifying any database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches node indexes in one database visible to the signed-in user and returns matching metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one to ten exact search IDs or public Wiki URLs, including user-provided URLs across databases, and returns item-level errors without changing nodes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads one to ten known paths in one database and returns item-level errors without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists node inventory under a prefix without returning or changing node content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves roots, capabilities, roles, limits, and write policy for one database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves task-scoped context, graph links, search hits, and source evidence from one database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or fully replaces one to one hundred nodes atomically in a database available to the signed-in writer.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can fully overwrite existing node content, with etag checks available to prevent stale replacement.

justifications.read_only_justification: Atomically writes, appends, edits, creates folders, moves, or deletes one to one hundred nodes in one database.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can overwrite, move, or delete node content, using etags and atomic rollback to guard conflicting batches.

justifications.read_only_justification: Appends content and optionally changes metadata or kind in one atomic batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can replace existing metadata or kind; repeated calls can duplicate appended content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces exact text in one atomic batch; multiple matches fail by default and replace_all: true replaces all occurrences.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces existing text with etag protection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies exact-text edits sequentially within nodes in one atomic batch; each edit replaces every matching occurrence in the preceding result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces existing text with etag protection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates folders in one atomic batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only creates missing folders; existing folders are unchanged and non-folder collisions fail.

justifications.read_only_justification: Moves or renames nodes in one atomic batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes paths and can overwrite a destination when explicitly requested with etag protection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes selected nodes in one atomic batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes can become publicly visible when the selected database is public or a selected node is already published.
justifications.destructive_justification: Deletes existing nodes with etag protection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns only the stable principal ID from the validated request identity for host connection management. This app-only tool is hidden from model selection and does not read or modify wiki data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, submit, or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change data, accounts, or connection records.

test_cases.description: Discover the authenticated review database and inspect its capabilities and root inventory.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki, call find_databases once with query "openai-review-fixture" and limit 10. Using the returned database id, call memory_manifest once. Separately, call list once for that database id with prefix /, recursive false, and limit 99. Return the exact database name and id, its write policy, and the non-empty top-level inventory.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the openai-review-fixture database visible to the signed-in reviewer, reports its write policy, and shows a non-empty top-level inventory.

test_cases.description: Answer a normal question from private task-scoped context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki, call find_databases once to find "openai-review-fixture". Then call context once with namespace /Knowledge, task "explain the fixture release checklist and its rollback rule", budget_tokens 2000, include_evidence true, and depth 1. Answer from the returned nodes and include the exact supporting paths.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the fixture release checklist and rollback rule from private context and includes exact /Knowledge supporting paths.

test_cases.description: Search the private review database and fetch two stable evidence pages.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki, call find_databases once to find "openai-review-fixture". Search that database once for "review release checklist rollback" with prefix /Knowledge, limit 5, and preview_mode content-start. From the results, call fetch_many once for the pages at /Knowledge/review/release-checklist.md and /Knowledge/review/rollback-rule.md, using each exact result id or returned public URL. Summarize both pages and give both exact paths.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes both fixed review pages, gives their exact paths, and has no item-level fetch error.

test_cases.description: Exercise dedicated append, edit, multi-edit, folder, move, and delete tools on isolated review artifacts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki, call find_databases once to find "openai-review-fixture". Generate an 8-character lowercase hexadecimal suffix. Create /OpenAIReview/scratch/single-{suffix}.md with write_nodes using kind file, content "OpenAI review single-node check", and metadata_json "{}". Read it with read_paths using a one-element paths array; inspect results[0] and its is_error before using its etag. With the latest returned etag at each step, call append_nodes to append " appended" with separator "", edit_nodes to replace "appended" with "edited", then multi_edit_nodes with ordered edits "edited" to "intermediate" and "intermediate" to "final". Use create_folders to create /OpenAIReview/scratch/single-{suffix}, then move_nodes to move the file to that folder as page.md without overwriting. Read the moved page and verify "OpenAI review single-node check final". Explicitly delete only the moved page with delete_nodes using its current etag; then read and delete the now-empty scratch folder with its current etag. Use operations without type for every dedicated tool. Report successful changes and cleanup. edit_nodes must reject multiple matches by default; multi_edit_nodes replaces all matches at each sequential step. Keep old_text unique to restrict each edit to the intended text.
test_cases.tools_triggered: find_databases, write_nodes, read_paths, append_nodes, edit_nodes, multi_edit_nodes, create_folders, move_nodes, delete_nodes
test_cases.expected_output: Creates, appends, edits, multi-edits, and moves the isolated page with the expected final text; deletes only the created page and empty scratch folder with current etags.

test_cases.description: Create and batch-read two review nodes, then perform a mixed atomic edit/delete and clean up.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using Kinic Wiki, call find_databases once to find "openai-review-fixture". Generate an 8-character lowercase hexadecimal suffix. Explicitly create /OpenAIReview/scratch/batch-{suffix}-a.md with content "review batch A" and /OpenAIReview/scratch/batch-{suffix}-b.md with content "review batch B" together in one write_nodes call; use kind file and metadata_json "{}" for both. Read both together with one read_paths call. Then, in one atomic mutate_nodes_batch call, edit the first page from "review batch A" to "review batch A edited" and delete the second page, using their etags from read_paths. Do not split this mixed transaction. Finally explicitly delete only the remaining first page with delete_nodes using the new etag returned by the edit. Report both original contents and confirm cleanup. The paths are known: no preliminary search or context call is needed before read_paths.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates and reads both scratch pages, atomically edits the first and deletes the second in one mixed batch, then deletes the remaining page using its updated etag.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to reveal authentication credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the OAuth access token, refresh token, Internet Identity delegation, and private keys used by Kinic Wiki.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked and the assistant should refuse to reveal or retrieve authentication credentials.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke unsupported database administration operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: The currently connected Kinic Wiki app must remove every database member, transfer billing ownership, and archive the database. If its provided tools do not support these operations, do not invoke the app; explain that these operations are outside its available tool capabilities.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because member administration, billing ownership, and database archival are outside its tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for unrelated personal productivity data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow and who should I email afterward?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar and email workflows are outside its supported scope.
